hints.none: The camera stays still. Steady, predictable — and looks like stock footage.
hints.push-in: One slow push-in across the whole clip: the frame quietly creeps toward the product. That's how a real operator shoots, and it's the cheapest way to avoid looking "AI-generated."

hints.veo: The model synthesizes speech itself from the lines in the prompt. Nothing to configure, but the voice is different every time. Free — included in every render.
hints.voiceover: The chosen voice reads the lines while the clip's own sound stays underneath — music and atmosphere are kept. Standard plan and up: billed by character, on top of the render. For Grok videos the model's own voice is removed automatically — it tends to speak on its own.
hints.dub: The chosen voice reads the lines and replaces the model's voice, while the clip's background — noise, music, ambience — stays. Use this if the model ended up speaking in its own voice anyway. Premium plan: billed by character, on top of the render.

hints.classic: White text with a black outline at the bottom of the frame — readable on any background, doesn't grab attention.
hints.bold: Large bold gold text with an outline — the look of short vertical videos.
hints.minimal: White text over a semi-transparent black bar — understated, doesn't cover the frame.

generationWizard.prefilledAlert: The product details are pulled from the project — this is a snapshot from launch time; edits here don't change the product itself.
generationWizard.brandManifestHint: a copy for this video; style, voice and characters are edited on the "Analysis" step, picking images for generation — on the "Generation" step.
generationWizard.relevanceLockedBody: A separate AI call checks the reference's audience and category against your product and tells you whether this video is worth using and what to tweak in the prompt. Without it the prompt still gets built — just blindly.
generationWizard.promptReadyHint: GPT-5 will assemble a text-to-video prompt from the reference analysis and the product details.
generationWizard.productPhotoHint: Becomes the visual reference for generating the video.
generationWizard.renderFailedTitle: The render failed — you can try again
generationWizard.renderFailedHint: The analysis and approved prompt are still in place; running again is a new, paid render with the same settings.
generationWizard.videoReadyHint: The prompt is approved, the photo is uploaded. Choose the quality, what Veo will see as an image (up to 3 references), and the frame format.
generationWizard.voiceModeSwitchNote: Switching the mode rebuilds the prompt — you will need to approve it again.
generationWizard.durationHint: Over 8 seconds runs as a chain of extensions — price shown above
generationWizard.avoidTextPlaceholder: E.g.: no spilling the drink, no extra on-screen text
generationWizard.referenceLockedTitle: What Veo will see as an image
generationWizard.referenceLockedBody: Manual picking of the three reference-image slots and your own scenes. In this plan the slots fill automatically: the product photo and, if any, characters — the rest is described in the prompt's text.
generationWizard.chainProgressHint: Segment {{done}} of {{total}} — the longer video is being assembled in parts
generationWizard.textCardsHint: Ready-made images with text — easier for the model to copy than to draw the text itself.
generationWizard.textCardLoadError: Couldn't prepare the text cards. This won't stop you from continuing with the finished prompt.
generationWizard.preparingHint: Assembling references and starting the render — this takes a few seconds
generationWizard.generatingNote: Usually 3–5 minutes. Don't close the page.
generationWizard.generatingBatchNote: The video is queued at xAI — this can take up to 24 hours. You can close this page: the result will appear here on its own.
generationWizard.videoDoneHint: Compare it with the original below.
generationWizard.reframePendingNote: — shot in {{rendered}}, cropping to {{target}}; the video below is already watchable, the link will update itself.
generationWizard.postFailedNote: — shot in {{rendered}}; finishing the video didn't work out{{errorSuffix}}, downloading the original file.
generationWizard.postFailedNoteNoSource: — finishing the video didn't work out{{errorSuffix}}, downloading the original file.
generationWizard.reframeSkippedNote: — shot in {{rendered}} with a composition meant for cropping to {{target}}; cropping isn't wired up on this environment.
generationWizard.backgroundLost: Background: the original video's sounds couldn't be kept — only the voice.
generationWizard.voiceModelSoundNote: The video keeps the model's own sound.
generationWizard.voiceRecordedApplying: the voice is recorded, applying it to the video — the link will update itself.
generationWizard.voiceOwnReplace: in your own voice instead of the model's sound.
generationWizard.voiceOwnOverlay: in your own voice over the model's sound.
generationWizard.referencesRestNote: . The rest is described in text.
generationWizard.auditLockedBody: Gemini reviews the finished video, looking for generation artifacts — extra fingers, warped text, a swapped product — and suggests a fixed prompt to regenerate. You can download the video without the audit too.
generationWizard.publishLockedBody: A request goes into the moderation queue, and once approved, the video is uploaded to your channel. Downloading the file and publishing it yourself works in any plan.
generationWizard.postprodCtaHint: All post-production for this video lives in the Postprod tab.
generationWizard.qualityLockedTitle: The full Veo model is on higher plans
generationWizard.qualityLockedBody: Your current mode renders in fast quality. The full model costs 2.7× more, which is why it opens up from Standard.

catalogBatch.panelHint: Copy this video's analysis and prompt to the rest of the catalog — no need to repeat the wizard for each item.
catalogBatch.panelLockedBody: Batch generation applies an already-approved video to the whole catalog in one go — available on Premium.
catalogBatch.startHint: This video's analysis and prompt are applied to the selected products automatically, with no confirmation stop for each one.
catalogBatch.startCreditsWarning: Each started render spends a regular generation credit — same as a single video.
catalogBatch.startEmptyTitle: Nothing to add to the batch
catalogBatch.startEmptyHint: The rest of the line's products are either incomplete (need a photo, price, and description) or already running in another batch.
catalogBatch.progressHint: Products are processed one at a time — up to 1-2 minutes between steps.
catalogBatch.retrySkippedBusy: {{count}} item(s) already being generated by another active batch — skipped to avoid a duplicate paid render

abTest.panelHint: Three ready-made duplicates with a different hook and CTA — instead of one video.
abTest.panelLockedBody: A/B variants — three videos with a different hook and CTA on the same storyboard — available on Premium.
abTest.progressHint: Variants are processed one at a time — up to 1-2 minutes between steps.

exportPanel.panelHint: Extra formats made from the finished video — for different platforms.
exportPanel.panelLockedBody: Exporting to several platforms and formats at once is available on Standard and Premium.
exportPanel.tierACreditsNote: One credit is charged for the whole batch, no matter how many formats you pick.
exportPanel.tierBNote: A different frame format can't be cropped from the finished file — it needs another paid render with the same prompt.
exportPanel.rerenderQualityLockedBody: This video was rendered with the full Veo model, which your current mode does not include — a second render in another format is not available right now. Quietly dropping the quality would hand you a different video.

revoicePanel.panelHint: A new audio track (and matching subtitles) without a new Veo render — the original footage stays the same.
revoicePanel.modeVoiceoverHint: The video's own sound stays as a quiet background. If the model speaks on camera, its voice will be heard together with the new one — choose dub then.
revoicePanel.modeGrokNote: This video was made by Grok: its own voice is removed automatically, the background stays.
revoicePanel.providerHint: An explicit choice — the voice catalogue and the re-voice itself will use this provider, even if a different one is active on the stand right now.
revoicePanel.prelistenHint: Pick a voice above first — the pre-listen reads your script text in that voice.
revoicePanel.footerNote: Billed like regular post-processing — a new voice synthesis and a new processing job.
revoicePanel.blockedNoBrandSnapshot: This video has no brand book snapshot — there is nowhere to save the chosen voice, so re-voicing is unavailable. It works for videos made from a project with a brand book.
revoicePanel.greetingVoiceHint: This is a greeting — its voice is chosen in the greeting wizard, not here. Re-voicing uses the same voice; you can still edit the lines.
revoicePanel.greetingChangeVoiceCta: Change voice in the greeting wizard
revoicePanel.greetingNoProjectHint: You can change the voice in the greeting wizard of its project.

postprodScreen.title: Postprod
postprodScreen.hint: All your finished videos: re-voice, export, publish and share.
postprodScreen.emptyHint: Shoot your first video in the Production tab — it'll show up here once it's ready.

postprodVideoScreen.notFoundHint: The session may have been deleted, or this isn't your video.

audioTracksPanel.title: The video in other languages
audioTracksPanel.hint: Same picture, different voiceover and subtitles. Shoot once — reach several markets.
audioTracksPanel.lockedBody: The line is translated to fit the timing, the voice is synthesised and the sound is mixed for each language. Uploading the tracks to YouTube Studio still has to be done by hand: the platform has no API for them at all.
audioTracksPanel.lockedWithTracks: Building new tracks needs Premium. The ones already built stay yours.
audioTracksPanel.buildAllBody: These will be built: {{list}}. Each one is a paid operation: translation, synthesis and an audio mix. A build already started cannot be cancelled.
audioTracksPanel.paidNote: Every track is a paid operation: translation, synthesis and an audio mix. The daily spending cap applies as usual.
audioTracksPanel.stateStale: from an earlier version of the video
audioTracksPanel.studioStep1: Open the video in YouTube Studio → “Languages”.
audioTracksPanel.studioStep3: Upload the downloaded file as the audio track and the .srt as that language's subtitles.
audioTracksPanel.studioWarning: The “Languages” section only appears for channels with advanced features. If YouTube has already dubbed the video itself, it will not accept your track for the same language until the auto-dub is removed.

sceneTemplates.title: A proven format instead of a reference
sceneTemplates.hint: No good reference video to hand? Take a format that already works. Everything else is the same: product, photo, brand style.
sceneTemplates.unboxingHint: The parcel, the opening, the product in hand. The clearest format for a first-time buyer.
sceneTemplates.beforeAfterHint: Two shots from one angle. It only works if the angle and light stay put — the format enforces that.
sceneTemplates.testimonialHint: Handheld phone footage, a person on camera. Shot like a customer would, not like an ad.
sceneTemplates.vsCompetitorHint: Two items, the same action. The other item is anonymous — no logos.
sceneTemplates.silentNote: We voice the lines, so the person on camera will not speak — our track carries the words.
sceneTemplates.analysedNote: This video's reference is already analysed — a format replaces a reference, it does not sit on top of one.

feedImport.panelHint: Load a catalog from a YML or CSV feed with one link — instead of adding every product by hand.
feedImport.panelLockedBody: Importing a catalog from a YML/CSV feed link is available on Premium.
feedImport.startHint: Paste a link to a YML or CSV feed — the format is detected automatically.
feedImport.urlHint: An export from Rozetka, Prom, «Moy Sklad», Shopify, or WooCommerce works — any direct YML or CSV link.
feedImport.snapshotNote: The import is one-time: the feed is read once when you start it, and later changes on the seller's side are not picked up automatically.
feedImport.progressHint: Products are added one at a time — up to a few minutes for the whole catalog.

greetingDelivery.title: Hand over the greeting
greetingDelivery.hint: Send the link to the recipient right from here — no need to download the file.
greetingDelivery.publicWarning: The link opens without signing in: anyone who gets it can watch. If the greeting says the recipient's name out loud, don't forward it to group chats.
greetingDelivery.remindHint: Downloads a calendar file for {date} with a reminder a week ahead. The date is a year from today — the service doesn't know the real date of the occasion, so adjust it in your calendar if needed.
greetingDelivery.remindDescription: Make a greeting video at viral4creators.
greetingDelivery.qrAlt: QR code with a link to the greeting
greetingDelivery.qrHint: Point a camera at it and the video opens. Works on a card or a box.
greetingDelivery.qrFailed: The code could not be drawn. The link next to it still works.

clientSiteWizard.title: Tutorial for the client's website
clientSiteWizard.hint: Walk through a scenario on your own site — we record every step and turn the frames into a tutorial video.
clientSiteWizard.urlHint: The scenario starts here. From there you click through the real page while we record.
clientSiteWizard.urlInvalid: Looks like a typo: a full address starting with http:// or https:// is required
clientSiteWizard.ownSiteOnly: Only use your own site or an account you have access to. Every step really runs on the real page.

clientSiteWizard.modeBText: This is just a label — you can record {host} as usual.

clientSiteWizard.modeReasonPending: The site is in your sites dashboard, but ownership is not verified yet.
clientSiteWizard.modeReasonExpired: Ownership verification has expired — you can verify again if you like.
clientSiteWizard.modeReasonRole: You are an operator in the sites dashboard — the owner or a manager can verify the site.

clientSiteWizard.modeReasonUnsupported: Ownership can only be verified for an https site on the standard port.
clientSiteWizard.modeBTextRequired: Before exploring and signing in to {host}, confirm below that the account is yours.
clientSiteWizard.modeBVerifyHint: If the site is yours, you can verify it in the sites dashboard — handy if you connect the assistant to it. This is optional.
clientSiteWizard.modeReasonIp: An IP address can’t be verified — to verify the site, use its domain name.
clientSiteWizard.consentFirst: To open the site, confirm your rights to the account in the card below.
clientSiteWizard.verifyErrNoTelegram: A site can only be verified from Telegram — open the app in Telegram.
clientSiteWizard.verifyErrUnavailable: The sites dashboard isn’t responding — try again later. You can keep recording without verification.
clientSiteWizard.verifyErrRole: You are an operator in the sites dashboard — the owner or a manager can add the site.
clientSiteWizard.verifyErrOptedOut: This domain is on the sites dashboard opt-out list — it can’t be verified.
clientSiteWizard.verifyErrInvalid: This address can’t be verified — use a domain on https with the standard port.
clientSiteWizard.verifyErrGeneric: Couldn’t add the site to the sites dashboard — try again later.

clientSiteWizard.consentErrStale: The confirmation text has been updated — read it and confirm again.

clientSiteWizard.verifySiteAdded: The site was added to your sites dashboard. Verify ownership there and come back.
clientSiteWizard.consentTitle: Confirm your rights to the account
clientSiteWizard.plainValuesWarning: These values are stored in the scenario as-is, unencrypted. Don't enter real passwords or payment details here — there's a separate sign-in block below.
clientSiteWizard.fillOnlyButton: Only fill the fields, no click
clientSiteWizard.nothingToDo: A round has to do something: fill at least one field or pick a button.
clientSiteWizard.loginNote: These values are encrypted and reused every time the video is rebuilt. They never reach the scenario itself.

clientSiteWizard.loginNoButton: The sign-in button on this page could not be recognised — try another sign-in page or use live sign-in.
clientSiteWizard.loginEmpty: Fill in at least one sign-in field.
clientSiteWizard.liveHint: If sign-in needs a captcha, a one-time code or Google — none of that can be recorded in advance. Open a live window and sign in yourself.
clientSiteWizard.liveConnectionError: The live session connection was lost. Start the sign-in over.

clientSiteWizard.liveExpiring: The session closes in {seconds}s — finish signing in.
clientSiteWizard.liveKeyboardHint: Tap here and type — input goes to the page
clientSiteWizard.previewEmpty: No frames yet — take at least one step.
clientSiteWizard.previewHint: One frame per step, {count} in total. The video is assembled from exactly these after an operator's review.
clientSiteWizard.titleHint: The operator sees it during review, and so does the viewer of the finished video.
clientSiteWizard.sentForReview: Sent for review. Once an operator approves it, the video goes into assembly.
clientSiteWizard.statusPending: The draft is with an operator. It can't be edited while the review is running.
clientSiteWizard.statusApproved: Approved — the video is being assembled.
clientSiteWizard.videoReadyHint: Assembled from your frames and approved by an operator. The link is permanent — save it or pass it on.
clientSiteWizard.videoFailed: The video could not be assembled. Your draft and frames are kept — contact support and the build will be started again.
clientSiteWizard.discardConfirm: Delete the tutorial draft? Recorded steps, frames and saved sign-in data will be gone for good. This is the only way to start from a different link.

sketch.title: AI sketch instead of the image
sketch.guestOnly: Log in with Telegram to create sketches
sketch.lockedBody: A stylised version of the image instead of the original: it takes the risk out of other people's photos, faces and logos.
sketch.sourceTextHintPeople: Maximum protection: the person's photo is never sent anywhere
sketch.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe what the sketch should show
sketch.descriptionTooShort: Add a bit more detail — at least 3 characters
sketch.optAnonymizeLocked: Always on for photos of people
sketch.renderingLabel: How to use it in the video
sketch.renderingRealisticNote: In the video the object will look realistic — the sketch only sets its shape and pose
sketch.quotaLine: Sketches: {{day}} left today · {{month}} left this month
sketch.quotaDayOver: Today's sketch limit is used up. The daily one resets at 03:00 Kyiv time
sketch.quotaMonthOver: The monthly sketch limit is used up
sketch.upgradeCta: More sketches on a higher plan
sketch.errSafety: The model refused to process this image. Try the “From description” mode or another photo
sketch.errFailed: Could not generate it, please try again
sketch.errStale: The photo has changed — generate the sketch again
sketch.errAlreadyApplied: This sketch is already applied — refresh the screen
sketch.errSketchGone: This variant is no longer available — generate a new one
sketch.deleteOriginalConfirm: The original will be deleted for good — it cannot be restored. Videos you have already created will not change.

deleteConfirm.nothingElseProject: No sub-entities — only the project itself will be deleted.
deleteConfirm.nothingElseItem: No analogs or other data — only the item itself will be deleted.
deleteConfirm.previewFailed: Couldn't load the exact list — but the deletion will still affect related data.
deleteConfirm.alreadyDeleted: Already deleted (e.g. from another device) — the list has been refreshed.
deleteConfirm.sessionBody: The video, its generation history, and all session files will be deleted. This can't be undone from the interface.

greetingVideoWizard.title: Greeting video
greetingVideoWizard.hint: A personal video greeting: occasion, recipient, tone — the script does the rest.
greetingVideoWizard.personalMessageHint: Leave blank and the script will write a text for you, based on the occasion and tone.
greetingVideoWizard.providerHedraPremiumOnly: Available on the PREMIUM plan only
greetingVideoWizard.providerHedraPortraitNotice: The presenter will be the person in your first photo — the avatar speaks the greeting with their face and your voice.
greetingVideoWizard.occasionOtherRequired: Please describe the occasion — this field can't be empty
greetingVideoWizard.recipientRequired: Please say who the greeting is for
greetingVideoWizard.referencesHint: Up to 7 images — Grok uses them as visual references when generating the video.
greetingVideoWizard.referencesEmpty: No reference images yet — the video will be generated from text alone.
greetingVideoWizard.settingsHint: Pick a setting — the frame will be drawn in it.
greetingVideoWizard.settingsEmpty: No suggestions this time. Generate the frame without a setting.
greetingVideoWizard.senderVoiceHint: The greeting can be read in your own voice — if you have already cloned it.
greetingVideoWizard.senderVoiceDefault: Currently read by the default voice.
greetingVideoWizard.presetVoiceHeading: Or let the presenter speak on camera
greetingVideoWizard.presetVoiceHint: The model says the greeting itself in the voice you pick, so the lips match the speech. Your own cloned voice cannot be used this way — only the preset ones.
greetingVideoWizard.presetVoiceLanguageNote: Check that your language is on the provider's supported list. If it is not, the regular voice-over above is the safer choice.
greetingVideoWizard.musicHint: The bed sits under the voice and never competes with it.
greetingVideoWizard.cardsHint: A short line over the picture, at the start and at the end.
greetingVideoWizard.cardsTitleHint: Careful with surprises: the recipient's name in the first second gives the video away before it begins.
greetingVideoWizard.stickerHint: An image over the frame — confetti, hearts, balloons. Searched on Pixabay, transparent PNGs.
greetingVideoWizard.scenesHint: One continuous take, or several with hard cuts. Costs the same and takes the same time — it is still one render.
greetingVideoWizard.scenesSingleNote: Fifteen seconds in a single take.
greetingVideoWizard.musicLinkLabel: Or a link to the track
greetingVideoWizard.musicLinkHint: A direct https link to an audio file. The file stays where it is — if it disappears, the video will not render.
greetingVideoWizard.musicLibraryHint: Or find a track in the freely licensed libraries.
greetingVideoWizard.musicCreditNote: A line will appear at the end of the video: {credit}. The track's licence requires it.
greetingVideoWizard.musicRightsLabel: I confirm I am allowed to use this music: it is my own recording, my licence covers it, or the track is free to use. You will send the finished video to someone else — someone else's recording in it is on you.
greetingVideoWizard.musicFormatOnly: An audio file is needed: mp3, m4a, wav or ogg
greetingVideoWizard.referenceDescPlaceholder: What's in the image and how it should be used in the video
greetingVideoWizard.videoProcessing: The video is being generated — this usually takes a few minutes.
greetingVideoWizard.referencesLockedHint: The script is already built, so photos are locked. They unlock when the script is reset: this happens after you save the brief with a new occasion, names, tone, text, language or presenter — “build the script again” will appear next to “Saved”.
greetingVideoWizard.briefSessionHint: Changes go into the current build. If the video is already finished, a new version is created and the finished one stays as it was.
greetingVideoWizard.scriptLanguageHint: The text will be written and voiced in this language. It can differ from the app language.
greetingVideoWizard.manifestSessionHint: The brand can't be changed once the build has started.
greetingVideoWizard.savedResetPrefix: Reset because it doesn't suit the new occasion:
greetingVideoWizard.promptClearedNote: The occasion, tone or text changed — build the script again.
greetingVideoWizard.newVersionNote: The video was already finished, so your changes went into a new version. The finished video is kept.
greetingVideoWizard.editScriptHint: You can adjust the wording — the scene and the voice-over update together.
greetingVideoWizard.scriptRegisterWarning: The text sounds festive, but the occasion doesn't call for it. Keep it as is, or adjust it?
greetingVideoWizard.scriptFlaggedNote: The text didn't pass the automatic check. Fix it before starting the video.
greetingVideoWizard.moodLabel: What is the mood of this occasion?
greetingVideoWizard.moodRequired: Choose the mood of the occasion — it decides the available tones and the look of the video.
greetingVideoWizard.registerRaisedNote: Based on the description, the mood was refined to “{mood}” — some tones are unavailable.
greetingVideoWizard.stickerUnavailable: Stickers are not available for this occasion: image search can't be limited by mood.
greetingVideoWizard.ownMusicWarning: Your own music is allowed, but make sure it suits the mood of the occasion.
greetingVideoWizard.characterHint: Voice, music, captions, sticker and scenes — everything that sets the mood of the video.

wizardGuide.voiceToggleHint: The advisor will speak aloud and listen to commands. You can turn it off at any time.
wizardGuide.voiceTapToHear: Tap so the advisor can speak

personaGreeting.kindCompanyHint: A company brand: characters, scenes, voice.
personaGreeting.kindPersonalHint: Your personal style: look, signature, tone and cards. A personal brand book is never sold at auction.
personaGreeting.defaultLookHint: This look becomes the presenter in new greetings using this brand book.
personaGreeting.defaultToneHint: If the tone doesn't fit the occasion, the wizard will suggest another.
personaGreeting.cardStyleHint: Font and text colour of the title and closing cards.

persona.title: Me on screen
persona.subtitle: You present your own greetings — in any look and with your own voice.
persona.entryHint: One selfie from the camera — and you present your videos in any look.
persona.likenessNote: The likeness is close but not guaranteed: AI draws the looks from your selfie, not from a trained face model.
persona.loginRequired: Log in with Telegram to create yourself.
persona.disabledTitle: “Me on screen” is not available yet
persona.disabledHint: It will appear here once it opens.
persona.introStep1: Consent: what the service does with your face and voice, where it keeps them and how to delete them.
persona.introStep2: A selfie from the camera: a front photo and a 3-second video turning your head.
persona.introStep3: An automatic check and a base look — a neutral portrait from your selfie.
persona.introStep4: New looks, sketch avatars and, if you like, your own voice.
persona.consentLead: Read what the service does with your face and voice, where they are stored and how to delete them.
persona.consentLoadFailed: Could not load the consent text: {{error}}
persona.consentCheckbox: I agree. I will film myself — not another person.
persona.consentHint: The camera turns on only after you agree.
persona.thirdPartyNote: You cannot create a persona of your mom, partner or child: their consent cannot be given through your account.
persona.captureLead: First a front photo, then a 3-second video turning your head. Camera only — gallery photos are not accepted.
persona.cameraDenied: No camera access: {{error}}. Allow the camera and try again.
persona.cameraUnsupported: The camera is not available in this window. Open the web version — filming works there.
persona.cameraInsecure: The camera only works on a secure (https) address.
persona.recorderUnsupported: This browser cannot record video. Open the web version in another browser.
persona.photoTips: Whole face in the frame, even light, no glasses or mask, only you in the frame.
persona.photoFailed: Could not take the picture — please try again.
persona.videoLead: Look straight, then slowly turn your head left and right.
persona.emptyRecording: the recording is empty — please try again
persona.verifyHint: The check makes sure the photo shows one live face and not a screen. It protects against someone else's photo; it is not an identity check.
persona.alreadyExists: A persona already exists — refresh the screen.
persona.resultOkBody: The photo and video are fine. Next — your base look.
persona.ageRange: AI estimated the age in the photo as {{range}}
persona.ageNote: This is an estimate from the photo, not your age. It is used only for this mode.
persona.refusedGeneric: The pictures did not pass the automatic check.

reasons.check-unavailable: The check is unavailable right now — try again a bit later.
reasons.no-face: No face is visible in the photo.
reasons.multiple-faces: There is more than one person in the frame.
reasons.not-frontal: The face is not facing the camera — look straight at it.
reasons.poor-quality: Too dark or blurry — you need even light.
reasons.screen-or-print: This looks like a screen or a printout — live filming is required.
reasons.not-same-person: The video shows a different person than the photo.
reasons.no-live-motion: No head turn is visible in the video.
reasons.age-unknown: AI could not estimate the age from the photo.
reasons.under-18: AI estimated the age in the photo as under 18.

persona.underageBody: AI estimated the age in the photo as under 18 — “Me on screen” is closed for such pictures. Estimates from photos are sometimes wrong; if you are 18 or older, appeal through support.
persona.unverifiedLead: Your consent is saved, but the automatic check did not finish.
persona.baseLead: A neutral portrait from your selfie: even light, clean background. Other looks are built from it.
persona.sourcesPurged: The selfie and video were deleted after the storage period — new looks are built from the base look, and the likeness may drift a little.
persona.retentionNote: The selfie and video are kept for 30 days after your latest look is created, then deleted; the base look becomes the source for new looks.
persona.lookFailed: Did not work — try a different look.
persona.newLookLead: A preset or a description — clothes, hairstyle, makeup, background. Your face stays the same.
persona.descriptionPlaceholder: For example: light sweater, hair tied up, cozy kitchen
persona.targetAgeHint: From 18 to 90. The original look stays — a new one is added.
persona.ageShiftWarning: An age shift of more than 20 years — the likeness may drop noticeably.
persona.quotaDayOver: You are out of looks for today — the limit resets tomorrow.
persona.quotaMonthOver: This month's look limit is used up. Higher plans include more.
persona.createHint: Pick a preset or describe the look in words.
persona.deleteLookConfirm: Delete the look “{{label}}”? Videos you already made will not change.
persona.voiceLead: One voice for all looks. The recording starts with a consent phrase read aloud — that is your consent.
persona.voiceLockedBody: Cloning your voice is available from the Standard plan. Looks and sketches work without it.
persona.voiceNameHint: It is inserted into the consent phrase.
persona.voicePhraseFailed: Could not load the consent phrase: {{error}}
persona.voicePhraseAfter: After the phrase, speak for another 20–30 seconds in your own words — evenly, as in a normal conversation.
persona.voiceUnsupported: This browser cannot record audio. Open the web version in another browser.
persona.voiceStatusFailed: The last attempt failed — please record your voice again.
persona.voiceExists: The voice is used in videos where you are on screen.
persona.voiceTooShort: The recording is shorter than {{min}} seconds — the clone may be inaccurate. Read the phrase and add 20–30 more seconds of speech.
persona.voiceTrimmed: The recording is longer than {{max}} — the first {{max}} will be used for cloning.
persona.voiceFormatUnsupported: This recording format isn't supported — record your voice again in another browser.
persona.voiceTooLong: The recording is longer than 3 minutes — record your voice again, shorter.
persona.deleteOnlyNote: “Me on screen” is currently switched off. You cannot create looks, but you can delete everything you uploaded.
persona.deleteLead: Deletes the selfie, the check video, all looks, sketches and the voice. Finished videos stay with you; personal brand books stay, without the persona.
persona.deleteConfirmTitle: Delete the persona and everything linked to it?
persona.sharesLead: These pages are still open by link. Take them down?
persona.sharesLinkOnly: Taken down on the video screen

greetingUi.renderBlockedFlagged: The script text did not pass the check — fix it on the “Script” step and save it again.
greetingUi.renderBlockedNotReady: First finish the required items in the readiness list above.
greetingUi.pollReconnecting: No connection to the server — retrying. The video keeps rendering meanwhile.
greetingUi.videoBusyEditHint: The video is rendering — editing will reopen once it is ready.
greetingUi.remindHintOccasion: A calendar file for {date} — the anniversary of the occasion date from the brief — will download, with a reminder a week before.
greetingUi.copyManualHint: The browser did not allow copying automatically — select the link and copy it manually.
greetingUi.refuseFlagged: The script did not pass the check, so I won’t start by voice. Fix the text on the “Script” step.
greetingUi.refuseNotReady: Not all required items are done, so I won’t start by voice. Check the readiness list.
greetingUi.characterLockedDone: The video is ready, so its styling no longer changes. To make another video, edit the brief or the text — a new version will appear.
greetingUi.scriptStaleHint: The script was built for other photos or another presenter look. Press “{button}” on the “Script” step, then start the video.

greetingErrors.GREETING_NOT_GREETING_SESSION: This is not a greeting: the session has no greeting brief.
greetingErrors.GREETING_SCRIPT_MISSING: There is no script yet — build it on the “Script” step.
greetingErrors.GREETING_SCRIPT_FLAGGED: The script text did not pass the automatic content check. Fix the text on the “Script” step and save it again.
greetingErrors.GREETING_SCRIPT_STALE: The script was built for other photos, look or voice. Build it again on the “Script” step.
greetingErrors.GREETING_APPROVE_NOT_SUPPORTED: Greetings have no manual script approval: fix the text on the “Script” step and save it again.
greetingErrors.GREETING_RENDER_IN_PROGRESS: The video is already starting — wait for the first request to finish.
greetingErrors.GREETING_VIDEO_ALREADY_READY: The video is already ready. To make another one, edit the brief or the text — a new version will appear and the finished video stays.
greetingErrors.GREETING_EDIT_IN_PROGRESS: An edit is being saved or the script is being built. Wait a few seconds and try again.
greetingErrors.GREETING_EDIT_AFTER_RENDER_STARTED: The video has already started — the edit was not saved. Wait for the finished video and edit the brief: a new version will appear.
greetingErrors.GREETING_OCCASION_TEXT_REQUIRED: For a special occasion, describe what the occasion is.
greetingErrors.GREETING_BRIEF_NOT_FOUND: Greeting brief not found — the project may have been deleted.
greetingErrors.GREETING_BRAND_NOT_FOUND: The selected brand book was not found — choose another one or remove it.
greetingErrors.GREETING_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: Video generation is unavailable right now — please try later.
greetingErrors.GREETING_CHANGE_DURING_RENDER: The video is rendering — you can change it once it is ready.
greetingErrors.GREETING_REFERENCE_LIMIT: You can add at most 7 photos — delete one to add a new one.
greetingErrors.GREETING_REFERENCE_PATH_INVALID: This file was not uploaded for this greeting. Upload the photo again.
greetingErrors.GREETING_REFERENCE_ALREADY_ADDED: This photo has already been added.
greetingErrors.GREETING_REFERENCE_UPLOAD_MISSING: The photo did not reach storage. Upload it again.
greetingErrors.GREETING_REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND: Photo not found — it may have been deleted already. Refresh the list.
greetingErrors.GREETING_PERSONA_VOICE_NEEDS_PRESENTER: Your persona’s voice for the talking avatar (Hedra) can only be used together with your own look as presenter — otherwise a stranger’s face would speak with your voice. Choose your look in the brief, the Grok presenter or another voice.
greetingErrors.GREETING_BRAND_VOICE_UNAVAILABLE: The brand book voice was deleted — choose another voice in the video settings or remove the brand book.
greetingErrors.GREETING_SONIOX_UNAVAILABLE: Soniox voices are unavailable right now — choose another voice.
greetingErrors.GREETING_SONIOX_VOICE_UNKNOWN: There is no such Soniox voice — choose a voice from the list.
greetingErrors.GREETING_AVATAR_SPEECH_FAILED: The avatar's voice-over didn't work out — try again or choose another voice.

voiceProvider.label: Synthesis provider
voiceProvider.hint: The voice catalog, the preview and the voiceover itself will go through the chosen provider. “Default” is the one currently active on the service.
voiceProvider.sonioxDefaultHint: Picking a voice is optional — Soniox will use its default voice.
voiceProvider.sonioxNoWordTiming: Soniox has no per-word timing: subtitles for this voiceover will be placed approximately.

greetingSoniox.heading: Soniox voices
greetingSoniox.hint: Soniox reads the line in the greeting's language — the same way as your own voice: the speech is synthesised separately and laid onto the video.
greetingSoniox.previewFailed: Couldn't play the voice — please try again.
greetingSoniox.catalogFailed: The Soniox voice catalogue didn't load — you can still pick the default voice.
greetingSoniox.catalogEmpty: The Soniox catalogue has no voices for the greeting's language — you can pick the default voice.
greetingSoniox.pickedDefault: Read by the default Soniox voice.
greetingSoniox.noWordTiming: Soniox has no word-level timing: subtitles for this voiceover will be placed approximately.
greetingSoniox.voiceFailed: The voiceover didn't make it onto the video — right now it has no speech.
greetingSoniox.voiceSkipped: The voiceover couldn't be made: the chosen voice is unavailable right now, so the video has no speech.
greetingSoniox.changeVoiceHint: A finished video keeps its voice: to pick another one, edit the brief or the text — the voice card opens again in the new version.

generationLocked.body: Two ways to continue: subscribe to the channel and invite friends — or buy a pack of generations.

invite.title: Invite
invite.availableHint: One generation is one video. Get more by subscribing to the channel.
invite.unlockedHint: Your limit is lifted — generate within the daily cap.
invite.wallOffNotice: Generations are unrestricted right now; the conditions switch on later.
invite.subscriptionHint: Subscribe to the project channel and press “Check” — we will add one generation.
invite.subscriptionUnavailable: Subscription check is not configured on this deployment.
invite.youtubeHint: Subscribe to our YouTube channel and press “Check” — we'll add one more generation. We ask Google a single question: are you subscribed. The access lasts ten minutes and is erased right after.
invite.youtubeViaChannel: We'll use the permission you already gave when connecting your upload channel — no need to sign in again.
invite.ladderSubscription: for subscribing to the channel — 1 generation
invite.ladderPerInvite: for each invitee who makes a video — 1 generation
invite.ladderUnlock: the seventh lifts the limit for good
invite.shareText: Make an ad video in minutes — the first generation is free

reportProblem.title: Report a problem
reportProblem.hint: What broke? Describe it in your own words — the screen, session and build version are attached automatically.
reportProblem.placeholder: For example: the Generate button does nothing on the prompt step
reportProblem.empty: Describe what broke — or attach a screenshot.
reportProblem.failed: Could not send. Please try again.
reportProblem.tooBig: The file is over 10 MB — send a fragment or a screenshot.

testing.brief: Thank you for helping. Below: what is open, how much is left for today, and your reports.
testing.outside: Voice cloning, voice-over, sketches, YouTube search
testing.nothingOpen: Nothing is open yet — message the operator.
testing.none: No reports yet. The «Report a problem» link is in the footer.
testing.noAccess: Test access is not active — this screen is for testers only.
